run_gpe_gpi_evaluation: run GPE/GPI evaluation on the balancing task with a fixed w using a pre-trained keyboard model
run_episode_with_agent: run a single episode using experiment.run_episode with a wrapped environment and regressed agent
load_keyboard_model: load a pre-trained keyboard model from a TensorFlow Hub path using SmartModuleImport
create_regressed_agent: create a regressed agent with a fixed init_w and disabled training via zero learning rate
wrap_environment_with_keyboard: wrap a scavenger environment with EnvironmentWithKeyboardDirect using a loaded keyboard model and additional discount
